name: Growl dropout
desc: A grittier, FM-fed Ab-minor sub: a touch of FM adds a growl edge over the sine fundamental while a per-cycle mask punches structural dropouts and nested half-drops into the low end. A four-cycle walk alternates the harmony and a slow lpf breathes over 8-16 cycles. Where .01 is a clean gated sub, this one is a darker, growling glitch bass.

code.full: note("<[ab1 ab1 ~ eb2 ab1 ~ gb1 ab1] [ab1 ab1 ~ db2 ab1 ~ bb1 ab1] [gb1 gb1 ~ db2 gb1 ~ eb2 gb1] [eb1 eb1 ~ bb1 eb1 ~ gb1 eb1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${grit}).fmh(2).fast(${rate}).attack(.006).decay(.22).sustain(.18).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).shape(.3).gain(${gain}).room(.1).mask("<1 1 [1 0] 1>").orbit(3).play()
